extended_mcv.finding: Extended MCV construction is separate; no extstats are created in this study.

native_sampling.finding: BlockSampler selects blocks; rows are scanned from accepted blocks; Vitter reservoir selects rows; the result is sorted by physical position for correlation; total rows are extrapolated from sampled blocks.
Scalar ordinary statistics use compute_scalar_stats and minrows=300*target.

ordinary_mcv.finding: Per-column MCV tracking is driven by sample rows and attstattarget.
Equality first checks MCV values; a miss uses remaining mass, null fraction, and estimated other distinct values.

planner_combination.finding: Conjunction selectivity is combined by PostgreSQL's clause-list machinery; this report uses independence products only as explanatory controls, not as a claimed exact reconstruction.
